notes: Looked at three frames a second across the whole part: the 15% tag drops and swings; 57% counts up on the coin; the receipt prints COFFEE then OLD USUAL TIP 90 cents on 'ninety' and the total; the three blocks rise on 'ninety', 'smallest' and 'biggest', the smallest button in red; the cheap button's tag, the old 90 cents crossed out on 'old'; the counter with the buttons popping on 'buttons'; the wipe into the flow, each box and arrow on its word. Nothing appears or vanishes without a move.
Titles build word by word as they are said, so a title whose words come late in its line (THE OLD USUAL TIP) fills in over the first seconds.
The narrator is the studio's placeholder voice. Claude cannot hear: the voice, music and sounds need Biku's ears.
